title: Fix memory leak in web socket listener
description: WebSocket connection remains open after logout causing browser performance degradation.

title: Implement OAuth2 refresh token rotation
description: Ensure tokens rotate securely and refresh tokens are invalidated upon logout.

title: Migrate dashboard charts to SVG rendering
description: Replace raster canvas charts with responsive SVG components for crisp display on high-DPI displays.

title: Optimize database queries on user profile load
description: Profile screen issues N+1 query pattern when fetching user organizations and role permissions.

title: Redesign notification bell dropdown menu
description: Update UI to match latest design system specs including unread indicators and clear-all actions.

title: Add multi-language localization for Spanish and German
description: Extract raw strings into translation bundles and support runtime locale switching.

title: Resolve session timeout modal clipping on mobile
description: When viewport width is below 480px, the confirmation modal overflows and primary CTA is hidden.

title: Implement CSV export for transaction logs
description: Provide synchronous CSV download for filtered audit tables with proper sanitization.

title: Update password strength meter requirements
description: Enforce minimum 12 characters and check against HaveIBeenPwned common passwords API.

title: Configure Content Security Policy headers
description: Lock down unsafe-inline scripts and restrict image sources to approved CDN domains.

title: Automate end-to-end checkout smoke test suite
description: Set up Playwright test workflow running nightly against staging environment.

title: Fix broken image upload preview for PNG files
description: FileReader fails on specific transparent PNG images due to incorrect MIME type detection.

title: Add keyboard accessibility shortcuts for table navigation
description: Implement ARIA grid navigation with arrow keys and focus trapping on modals.

title: Upgrade build pipeline to Node 22 LTS
description: Bump Docker base images and verify CI runner compatibility with updated dependencies.

title: Implement automated SSL certificate renewal
description: Certbot cron job configured with Let's Encrypt and webhook alert on renewal failure.
